name: Koi ni, Kanmi o Soete 2
source:
This is the continuation of CANVAS+GARDEN’s doujin title Koi ni, Kanmi o Soete, featuring after stories for Rira and Rishie and main routes for Ciel and Koron. 

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/12/16/december-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
这是CANVAS+GARDEN同人作品《尚有佳蜜伴恋心》的续作，包含莉良与璃贝的后日谈，以及希耶尔和可隆的主线。

[来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/12/16/december-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
